results.name: nist_codata_live_fundamentals
results.claim: Live NIST CODATA allascii (no credentials) parses SI/metrology anchors (c, h, k_B, fine-structure, electron mass) agreeing with accepted values within 0.01% relative residual. Note: γ and Catalan G are mathematical seeds scored separately vs open literature (not listed in NIST fundamental allascii).

results.name: seed_gamma_catalan_open_literature
results.claim: FSOT γ (Euler–Mascheroni) and Catalan G match published open-literature multiprecision anchors within 0.01% (expected machine-epsilon class).

results.name: seed_math_identities
results.claim: φ, e, π, η_eff, ψ_con identities hold at double precision vs math definitions with relative residual ≤ 1e-10 %.

results.name: pubchem_aspirin_mw_integrity

results.name: chembl_aspirin_mw_integrity
